newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan children hard hit by economic crisis.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan children hard hit by economic crisis.

text.p: At least 4.5 million young Venezuelans, 20 percent of the population, live in critical poverty, a non-governmental organization said on Friday.

A study by the respected Center for Community Learning (Cecodap) also said that 90 percent of children from poor families dropped out of school for economic reasons and 1.2 million children worked in the informal economic sector.

"Children's rights in Venezuela are not really respected because no government ever made it a priority,", Nancy Montero, president of the government-run National Children's Institute, told the daily El Nacional.
Cecodap head Francisco Pereira said in the study the number of children "who prostitute themselves for food is growing."
A previous Cecodap report showed a 200 percent rise in murders committed by children aged under 18 in Venezuela between 1989 and 1994.
Of a total 22 million Venezuelans, 70 percent are under 30.
